title: Sierre-Zinal rules — aid stations and cut-off times (art. 20–21)
claims: Article 20 lists official aid stations at Beauregard km 4, Ponchette km 7.5, Chandolin km 12, Tignousa km 16, Hotel Weisshorn km 20, Nava km 24 (water only) and Barneuza km 27.
Article 20 says water at Beauregard and Ponchette is limited because of supply logistics and asks runners to use it reasonably.
Article 21 gives cut-off times of 10:40:59 (Tourist) and 14:10:59 (Runner) at Chandolin, 12:00:59 and 14:40:59 at Tignousa, 13:30:59 and 15:20:59 at Hotel Weisshorn, and a final 17:30:59 at Zinal.
The organiser reserves the right to modify the cut-off times.
